mapper.select: SELECT so.id, so.stocktake_no, so.warehouse_id, w.warehouse_name, so.stocktake_date, so.stocktake_scope, so.stocktake_mode, so.freeze_mode, so.blind_count, so.order_status, so.confirm_time, so.confirm_by, cu.nickname AS confirm_by_name, so.remark, so.create_by, u.nickname AS create_by_name, so.create_time FROM wms_stocktake_order so LEFT JOIN wms_warehouse w ON so.warehouse_id = w.id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON so.create_by = u.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_user cu ON so.confirm_by = cu.user_id WHERE so.id = #{id} AND so.deleted = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wms_stocktake_order WHERE stocktake_no LIKE CONCAT(#{prefix}, '%') AND deleted = 0
